meta.name: springboot-migration
meta.description: Migrates Spring Boot applications to Boot 4 with Java 25, including related Spring Modulith 2 and Testcontainers 2 upgrade work. Use when the task is a concrete upgrade, dependency transition, starter rename, test-annotation migration, or phased migration plan. Do not use for greenfield project creation or for isolated repository design questions.

copy.tagline: 将 Spring Boot 应用升级到 Boot 4 和 Java 25
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在将 Spring Boot 应用从旧版本迁移到 Boot 4 和 Java 25
copy.tagline_en: Migrate Spring Boot applications to Boot 4 and Java 25
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are migrating Spring Boot apps to Boot 4 and Java 25

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会扫描现有 Spring Boot 项目，识别需要升级的部分，然后按顺序分阶段执行升级：先更新依赖，再修改源代码，接着调整配置，最后验证测试。每次升级后都会报告进度和问题。
howto.when: 当你要求升级现有的 Spring Boot 应用，特别是从 Boot 3.x 升级到 4.x，或涉及 Spring Modulith、Testcontainers 的版本升级时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫描这个 Spring Boot 项目，看看需要升级哪些部分。
say.note: Claude 会运行扫描脚本并列出待迁移项。

say.text: 升级完成后，帮我验证测试是否通过。
say.note: Claude 会运行单元测试、集成测试等并报告结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scans the existing Spring Boot project, identifies upgrade items, then executes migration in phases: update dependencies, modify source code, adjust configuration, and verify tests. It reports progress after each phase.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to upgrade an existing Spring Boot application, especially from Boot 3.x to 4.x, or involving Spring Modulith or Testcontainers version upgrades.

say_en.text: Scan this Spring Boot project and list what needs upgrading.
say_en.note: Claude runs the scan script and outputs migration items.

say_en.text: Upgrade my Spring Boot 3 project to Boot 4 and Java 25.
say_en.note: Claude executes phased migration and reports progress.

say_en.text: After upgrade, verify that all tests pass.
say_en.note: Claude runs unit, integration, and container tests and reports results.
